_game_selection_rationale: LAN vs NYN 2024-09-16 is the primary gold-game candidate for these reasons:
1. PERIOD: 2024 regular season — aligns with the existing retrosheet-fixtures/2024 corpus, so the
same TEAM2024 format is exercised end-to-end.
2. PLAYS: 61 cwevent event rows across 9 full innings. AT-BAT RANGE: 50-70 plate appearances,
well within the 50-80 target in BUILD.md. No extra innings, no suspended game complexity.
3. GRAMMAR COVERAGE: the hand-authored EVN exercises all reduced-grammar constructs:
hits (S/D/T/HR with and without fielder), strikeout K, walk W, HP, IW, error E6,
stolen base SB3, caught stealing CS2(26), defensive indifference DI,
advance strings (.1-2, .1-H, .2-H, .3-H), modifier /F /L /G, sacrifice fly /SF concept,
multi-fielder chains 6-4-3 4-3 5-3 6-3 3-6, single-fielder fly 8, inside-park HR/F.
4. NARRATION-FRIENDLY: 2024 Mets/Dodgers is heavily documented in box scores, play-by-plays,
and broadcast footage — easy to narrate from public sources.
5. BEACHHEAD ALIGNMENT: LAN/NYN is a nationally covered game a serious scorer would recognise,
but play complexity stays within the reduced grammar (~95% deterministic, ~5% judgment) —
matching the amateur/serious-scorer beachhead population's realistic game.
6. FREE THIRD CHECK: once the human produces an independent EVN, cross-diff against the
published Retrosheet file (download from retrosheet.org/game.htm, 2024 season event files)
gives a free third independent validation.

scorers.reisner: PLACEHOLDER — human scorer (see HUMAN_HANDOFF.md step H-2)
scorers.retrosheet: PLACEHOLDER — independent scorer (see HUMAN_HANDOFF.md step H-3; MUST differ from reisner scorer or be same scorer on different day)

cwevent_verdict._note: Set to false until the HUMAN-produced independent EVN is verified (current EVN is the harness scaffold — see HUMAN_HANDOFF.md). When the human delivers retrosheet/<GAMEID>.EVN and it passes retrosheet-gate.sh with zero stderr warnings, set passed=true and fill in run_at + event_rows_emitted.

_published_evn_note: Download from https://www.retrosheet.org/game.htm (2024 season, select LAN home games). Rename to published.EVN and place in retrosheet/. The cross-diff step in HUMAN_HANDOFF.md validates our independently-produced EVN against this file.
_h3_note: h3_ready becomes true ONLY when: (1) cwevent_verdict.passed==true on the HUMAN-produced EVN, (2) scorers.reisner != scorers.retrosheet (or documented independence), (3) reisner/scorecard.json is present, (4) audio/narration.m4a or audio/narration.txt is present. Until then all accuracy metrics are SELF-CONSISTENCY (advisory) per INTERFACE.md §3.4.
